positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Project planning focusing on the ability to develop logical plans to solve problems based on
requirements in a team environment
• Contract for the FAA in support software performing functional analysis of data and network
design, translating customer requirements into hardware and software specifications
• Perform documentation and metric collections for government delivery.

positions.title: Resident Assistant (RA)
positions.description:
• Serve as a member of the student staff at Oakland Hall, supervising the conduct and well-being of 900+ Residents based on the policies of the University of Maryland, College Park.
• Develop and conduct programs highlighting Academic Success, Community Engagement, Diversity and Global Consciousness, Holistic Wellness, and Identity Exploration. 
• Encourage the healthy growth and development of students living within the Residence Hall Community academically and socially.
• Enforce college policy, and manage tasks such as incident reports, maintenance requests, etc.

positions.title: North Campus Facilities Supervisor
positions.description:
• Ensured facilities are kept safe for all the students, faculty, and their guests
• Directly supervised Facility Staff and provided indirect supervision of Member Services, Weight
and Fitness, Outdoor Recreation and Aquatic employees
• Worked with a team of students to ensure facility is well staffed and operational

positions.title: Student Software Engineer
positions.description: Lockheed Martin IS&GS Federal IT Division and Leidos have merged forming the biggest US Federal IT vendor starting August 16, 2016.

positions.title: Store Manager
positions.description:
• Managed three stores that provided necessities to the residents
• Handled financial documents and budgets of the stores
• Ensured all the stores were stocked and employees reported to work on time
